question: During the Chlor-Alkali process, which of the following products is NOT obtained directly from the electrolysis of brine?

options.text: Sodium metal deposited at the cathode

solution:
The correct answer is __**Sodium metal deposited at the cathode**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Chlor-Alkali process** involves the electrolysis of brine (a concentrated solution of sodium chloride, NaCl).
 
• During the process:
 
 
• **Chlorine gas** is released at the anode due to the oxidation of chloride ions (Cl⁻).
 
• **Hydrogen gas** is produced at the cathode by the reduction of water molecules (H₂O).
 
• **Sodium hydroxide (NaOH)** is formed as a by-product and remains in the solution.
 
 
 
• **Sodium metal** is not deposited at the cathode because water is reduced preferentially over sodium ions due to its lower reduction potential.
 
• The products obtained directly from the process are **chlorine gas, hydrogen gas, and sodium hydroxide**.
